case_number: 2024 INSC 898; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP(Civil) No(s). 15782 of 2023) and multiple other civil appeals
summary: Land acquisition under urgency provisions Sections 17(1) and 17(4) of Land Acquisition Act, 1894; validity challenged by landowners; notification dated 26 February 2009 for planned development in Gautam Budh Nagar; Allahabad High Court decisions appealed; delay condoned; abatement set aside; substitution and transposition allowed; civil appeals grouped into two batches; Batch 1: landowners challenging Kamal Sharma case; Batch 2: YEIDA challenging Shyoraj Singh case; land acquisition for Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority; urgency provision scrutiny; application for intervention granted.
final_judgment: Delay condoned; abatement set aside; substitution allowed; transposition allowed; intervention granted; leave granted; civil appeals disposed analogously.
